headline: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif urged banks to disburse Rs1 trillion in subsidised Apna Ghar housing loans over the next six months, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Apna Ghar loans to be disbursed in six months

caption:
PM sets a Rs1 trillion home loan target for banks! 🏠
According to Arab News, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Monday urged banks to disburse Rs1 trillion ($3.6 billion) in subsidised housing loans under the Apna Ghar programme over the next six months. "In the next six months, we should have a disbursement of Rs1,000 billion," he said at an event marking the programme's first Rs100 billion in payouts. Eligible first-time buyers can borrow up to Rs10 million for up to 20 years, at a subsidised 5 percent rate for the first decade. Finance Ministry figures for Oct. 30 show 17,697 loans worth Rs104 billion issued so far.
